query: I just got back from the weekend farmers' market, I picked up the juiciest peaches I've ever tasted, they were so ripe they practically oozed sweet juice when I bit into one. I also got a small potted basil plant to put on my kitchen windowsill, I've been wanting to grow my own fresh herbs to add to pasta and salads for months now. Oh, and I saw a street performer playing the fiddle there today, they played a cover of my favorite old folk song and I ended up staying to listen for almost twenty minutes before I remembered I had errands to run. But the reason I'm calling is that my mobile service isn't working at all right now: my phone has airplane mode turned on, I think I messed up my network preference settings, my Wi-Fi calling is acting up, my APN MMS settings are broken, some of my apps don't have storage permission enabled, my data mode is turned off, I already used up all my data for the month, I think my SIM card might have come loose, I'm currently traveling abroad and I didn't turn on roaming, so I can't send texts, make calls or use mobile data at all.
